<function name="GetDark" parent="DLabel" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether the <page>DLabel</page> should set its text color to the current skin's dark text color.

See <page>DLabel:SetDark</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean"></ret>
	</rets>
</function>
